headline: Board of Variances and Appeals

meeting.summary: The board adopted an amended decision to settle a court appeal over a vacation rental and approved its meeting calendar.
meeting.recap: The first item was an appeal of a planning director's decision about a Lānaʻi property.[[0:01:27]] The parties agreed to move its scheduling conference to December 10th, 2026.[[0:02:06]] The board approved the delay by unanimous consent.[[0:02:45]] The second item was an appeal over the closure of a bed and breakfast permit.[[0:03:00]] The board set November 12th for that appeal by unanimous consent.[[0:05:37]] The board took up a petition about a vacation rental at 242 Luna Road, ʻUlupalakua.[[0:05:50]] The board's lawyer said the Planning Department had appealed the board's decision to circuit court.[[0:10:17]] The lawyer said the department and the petitioners settled, pending board approval of an amended decision.[[0:11:15]] The lawyer said the change adds an explanation but keeps the board's ruling the same.[[0:11:24]] The added explanation says residential uses do not have "hours of operation.".[[0:11:44]] The board voted unanimously to adopt the amended decision and order.[[0:15:09]] The board approved its meeting calendar with five votes.[[0:17:02]] A commissioner said the board has six members instead of nine.[[0:17:56]] The next meeting is September 24th.[[0:21:28]]
decided: The board set November 12th for the bed and breakfast permit appeal by unanimous consent.
The board approved its proposed meeting calendar with five votes.
meeting.next: Staff asked members who know interested applicants to email staff so they can check with the office that appoints members. Board members were asked to start thinking about who will serve as chair and vice chair.
